title: Fix pipeline_error_handler reporting a retried-then-succeeded activity as a run failure
description: pipeline_error_handler re-raised whenever any harvested activity row carried status Failed. queryactivityruns returns one row PER ATTEMPT, so an activity the pipeline retried into success appears as N Failed rows plus one Succeeded row — and the run was reported Failed even though it completed green. Observed on the 2026-08-03 14:08 orchestrator run: bronze_WGI failed twice against a degraded World Bank API and succeeded on its third attempt; the run was functionally green end to end yet ended red. retryAttempt is always null on this endpoint, so the final attempt has to be derived by ranking activityRunStart — the same signal derive_retry_attempt already uses. Left unfixed this becomes a false-alarm generator the moment task-010 puts the pipeline on a schedule, which is the failure mode that trains people to ignore alerts.
acceptanceCriteria: An activity that failed one or more attempts and then succeeded does NOT fail the pipeline run.
An activity whose final attempt failed DOES still fail the run, so task-026's DQ gate and DEC-004's failure propagation are preserved.
Every attempt is still written to gold_pipeline_execution_log, including the failed attempts of a recovered activity — get_retry_effectiveness() reads exactly that per-attempt detail.
The final attempt is identified by ranking activityRunStart, not by reading retryAttempt (which queryactivityruns always returns as null).
Recovered activities are reported in the notebook output so a retry storm stays visible rather than silent.
The decision logic is a pure function extracted and tested from the live notebook per the reference-implementation contract.
